shortDescription: The yen’s move beyond 160 per dollar has put traders on alert for possible intervention by Japanese authorities, according to Bloomberg.The breach underscores the currency’s vulnerability to further weakness and the heightened risk of officials stepping back into the market to slow its decline.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Yen Breaks 160 Against Dollar, Raising Intervention Risk
